title: saltugilia grinnellii
intro: Saltugilia grinnellii, commonly known as Grinnell's sage, is a species of flowering plant in the phlox family. It is native to the mountainous regions of the western United States. The health benefits of Saltugilia grinnellii include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Saltugilia grinnellii include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds and flavonoids.
